svg.text: DESK KNOB F1 — USB-C interface and ESD protection
USBLC6-2SC6: USB 2.0 data ESD clamp; VBUS reference = 5V
DESK KNOB F1 — USB power and switched peripherals
TLV75533: 5V USB to 3.3V; 500mA rated; C5/C6 ceramic
TPS22919: 1.5A load switch; GPIO1 low disables LCD and IR
5V USB / 3.3V logic / suspend-controlled display and encoder
DESK KNOB F1 — RP2040 power, controls and programming
3.3V I/O and USB; internal regulator supplies DVDD at 1.1V. TESTEN and exposed pad to GND.
J4: VREF sense / SWDIO / SWCLK / RUN / GND / BOOTSEL. Ground BOOTSEL during reset for USB UF2.
RP2040 / local bypassing / 1.1V core regulator / SWD
DESK KNOB F1 — Optical rotation encoder
TCUT1600: dual optical channels; 150R IR drive, nominal 14mA
SN74LVC2G17: 3.3V Schmitt buffers to PIO quadrature
48-slot optical ring / common-collector dual sensor / PIO quadrature
DESK KNOB F1 — Persistent turn storage
DESK KNOB F1 — User controls and status
GPIO0 internal pull-up; short press selects mode; hold 3s clears turns
Front side button / Scroll or Count mode / hold 3s to clear turns
DESK KNOB F1 — Round display and laptop dashboard
J6: keyed JST-SH 8-pin; H1 crimped SH-to-PH cable; anchors to GND
RP2040 boot flash, clock and USB termination
DESK KNOB F1 — RP2040 boot flash, 12MHz clock and USB termination
Winbond W25Q16JVSNIQ: 2MB boot flash; BOOTSEL is isolated from QSPI CS by 1k.
ABM8-272-T3: 12MHz, CL10pF / 50ohm ESR; 15pF loads and 1k series damping per Raspberry Pi reference.
2MB Winbond flash / Abracon ABM8 clock / USB series resistors
